title: 第3章 好感度提升第4章 病情加重每周两颗圣丹
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: 感受着耳边传来的炙热气息，柳如烟不知为何，下意识就答应了下来。
等她反应过来后，为时已晚。
就这样，时间很快又过去了两个小时。
徐墨推开房门，一脸的神清气爽，脸上还挂着意犹未尽的笑容，要不看柳如烟实在经不起鞭策，他甚至可以再战斗两个小时。
而且他发现有了太阳圣体后，他在双修运转龙凰合欢诀时，修炼速度快了不止一点。
再加上柳如烟有着特殊体质，他刚突破的修为竟然又提升了少许，虽然还不足以突破到炼虚，但相信再多来个几十次，应该也差不多了。
反观柳如烟，则是捂着小腹，一瘸一拐的跟在徐墨身后。
她本以为徐墨第二次也就半个小时而已，想不到竟是两个小时，竟然比第一次的时间还长。
她十分不理解，毕竟大多数人都是越往后时间越短，徐墨那方面为何会这么强！
“徐墨，我已经助你修炼了，还是两次！
快把圣丹交给我。”
柳如烟紧咬银牙，强忍着小腹的酸痛，对着面前的徐墨说道。
听到这句话，徐墨的内心冷哼一声。
别说他现在手里没有圣丹，就算是真有，他也不会给柳如烟的。
现在他巴不得叶峰死了才好。
因为刚才他脑海中的第二个金手指，那本充满岁月气息的无字书，不知何时已经翻开了第一页，并显现了一段文字。
同时一道信息也传入了他的脑海，让他知道了这本书的具体运用。
这本书的名字叫岁月之书，书里记载着这个世界未来一段时间所发生的事，和气运之子们未来会遇到的机缘。
届时徐墨可提前查看，规避危险，同时截胡气运之子们的机缘。
第一页写的正是关于叶峰和徐墨自己的。
根据岁月之书上面描述的内容，徐墨方才知道那个叶峰，居然也是身负大气运的气运之子。
而且还是最高等级的紫色，只比传说中的七彩气运差一级。
书上还说一个月后，叶峰将突破合体，会在圣火秘境，以雷霆万钧之势将徐墨一拳轰杀。
在杀掉徐墨后，叶峰便会夺得圣火传承，成为未来新一代圣火大帝！
虽说徐墨不知道叶峰为何一个月后会那么强，但是为了防止悲剧上演，他现在不得不当一个反派了！
不过不知为何，徐墨还有点小兴奋～
同时，他也改变了不给柳如烟“圣丹”
的主意。
content_en:
"Okay..."
Feeling the hot breath coming from her ears, Liu Ruyan subconsciously agreed for some reason.
By the time she reacted, it was too late.
…
Just like that, another two hours passed quickly.
Xu Mo opened the door, looking refreshed and with a smile on his face. If Liu Ruyan couldn't stand the push, he could have fought for another two hours.
Moreover, he discovered that after having the Sun Sacred Physique, his cultivation speed was more than a little faster when performing the Dragon-Phoenix Joyous Jue.
Coupled with the fact that Liu Ruyan has a special physique, his newly achieved cultivation level has actually improved a little. Although it is not enough to achieve the breakthrough of refining the void, I believe that if he does it dozens more times, it should be almost there.
Liu Ruyan, on the other hand, covered her belly and limped behind Xu Mo.
She thought Xu Mo's second visit would only last half an hour, but she didn't expect it to be two hours, longer than the first time.
She didn't understand very much. After all, most people's time shortened as time went by. Why was Xu Mo so strong!
"Xu Mo, I have already helped you practice, twice!
Give me the holy elixir quickly. "
Liu Ruyan clenched her silver teeth, endured the pain in her lower abdomen, and said to Xu Mo in front of her.
"Hmph!"
Hearing this sentence, Xu Mo snorted coldly in his heart.
Not to mention that he didn't have the Holy Pill in his hand now, even if he did, he wouldn't give it to Liu Ruyan.
Now he wishes Ye Feng was dead.
Because the second golden finger in his mind just now, that wordless book full of time, had opened the first page at some point, and a paragraph of text appeared.
At the same time, a piece of information was also passed into his mind, letting him know the specific application of this book.
The name of this book is the Book of Years. The book records what will happen in this world in the future, and the opportunities that the children of destiny will encounter in the future.
At that time, Xu Mo can check in advance to avoid danger and at the same time cut off the opportunities of the children of luck.
The first page is written about Ye Feng and Xu Mo himself.
According to the content described in the Book of Years, Xu Mo just knew that Ye Feng was actually a son of great fortune.
And it is the highest level of purple, only one level worse than the legendary colorful luck.
The book also said that one month later, Ye Feng would break through and merge, and would kill Xu Mo with a thunderous punch in the Holy Fire Secret Realm.
After killing Xu Mo, Ye Feng will obtain the Holy Fire inheritance and become the new generation of Holy Fire Emperor in the future!
Although Xu Mo didn't know why Ye Feng would be so strong a month later, in order to prevent tragedy from happening, he had to become a villain now!
But for some reason, Xu Mo is still a little excited~
At the same time, he also changed his mind not to give Liu Ruyan the "Holy Pill"
idea.
